description: The City Operated Electric Vehicle Charging Station Map is a dataset listed in City of Toronto open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Toronto. The map shows an expanding network of publicly accessible electric vehicle (EV) charging stations operated by the City of Toronto. The City provides public EV charging stations at both on-street and off-street parking facilities, which are managed by Toronto Parking Authority (TPA), an agency of the City of Toronto. Coverage: Toronto. The portal files it under the publisher City of Toronto. It offers 8 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, GPKG, SHP. The portal shows 2026-02-20 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-toronto-portal.
